reviews.comment: I took him back in fall 23 my freshman year. I'm leaving a late review, but I came back to say he is still my favorite professor 2 years later. He showed amazing improvement throughout the year and was very receptive to feedback. He gave us a "best of luck in all future endeavors!" pencil and I've used it on every exam to this day for good luck.

Teaches pretty well but felt like he slowed down after a horror show of a first test (average ~50). Overall class was fun and learned a lot but a couple of the HWs were annoying and first test was too long. He is very nice and very receptive for questions. Also answers emails in 5-10 minutes so he does his best. Just needs to rework assignments.
Excellent professor, cares about students, and makes his own tests so they are pretty easy. Overall, one of the best you can get in the math department.

I feel like Calculus 2 wasn't as bad as what others have told me many thanks to Professor Chu. I enjoyed it quite a lot and it's been my favorite math class so far. I would definitely sacrifice a good schedule just to take a class with him again if I could in the future.

Dr. Chu is the best math professor I've ever had. He explains concepts so can you understand intuitively. Practice exams are close to the real exam. If you ever need help, go to his office hours. He is also extremely kind, funny, and cares a lot about his students succeeding. He gives gifts if the class does well on exams :) just take his class!!

I would 100% recommend Dr. Chu! He cares a lot about his students, and he makes your time in class worthwhile. He structures his lectures so that you understand the big idea in each lecture. He responds to his emails in less than 15 minutes (mostly). If you have to take a class that he teaches, he is probably one of the best professors on campus!

Dr. Chu is the goat. Very funny guy and really wants you to succeed. He will answer any question you have and cares a lot about how you do in the class. Homeworks can take a while, but if you understand the problems on the homework, you'll do well on the test. If you do the provided practice tests, you'll know whats exactly on your exam.

I have nothing negative to say about Professor Chu, if he's available take him. He's so caring and just loves his students and we loved him. His tests are easy and every resource is given to do well in the class. He wants every single person to be on the same page and is open to any question. Bonus, he gave us commemorative pencils for our time :")

Easily the best math professor I've ever had. He made class engaging and interesting. He will answer any question you have in depth. He deeply cares for his students and you can tell how passionate he his. TAKE HIM!!

Best math professor I have ever had. Class is hard, but if you go to lectures and actively learn you will not have to study too hard outside of class. He is very engaging and visibly cares about all of his students. He will respond to emails within 5-10 minutes no matter the time of day or night. He made the lectures worth going to, even at 9am.

Really great guy. He cares a lot about his students and learns everyone's names. He wants you to do well and his office hours are very helpful. If you do all the practice problems in the notes, you should be fine for all quizzes and exams.

Incredibly passionate about teaching and inspiring students. Makes an effort to learn and remember everyone's name, even when teaching multiple large sections. He really cares about his students and wants to help us succeed.

Very caring and dedicated professor despite being new to teaching. Lectures are extremely detailed with many examples. Exam questions are similar to the example problems taught during lectures. Attend the lectures, they are worth it.

He loves teaching math and it encourages everyone to put in the effort for the class. He remembers everyone by name even in a section of 100-200 students. He gives out a lot of old exams that prepare you for the tests. The lectures are very helpful in understanding the homework. I recommend printing out the lecture notes ahead of the lecture.

Dr. Chu is the goat of all professors. He is truly passionate about math and makes it a lot enjoyable. Super hilarious guy as well, never had a dull lecture with him. He posts all lecture notes and practice exams which are very helpful. Office hours are super helpful, and he will even respond to emails at 2 AM. Your success is his top priority!

Dr. Chu was the most caring and inspirational professor I have ever had. He cares about the mental health and academic success of all his students and very quick to respond to emails (even at insane times). Your grade will definitely reflect your effort as he is a very fair grader.

Dr. Chu is a wonderful lecturer, He is very passionate about this class and wants his students to be as well, He gives amazing feedback if requested, and is very personable. His tests were difficult but he provided lots of resources to do well, and he set his students up to succeed. He gets very involved with his students and makes the class fun.
He posts his notes and is so chill and funny. Made Calculus enjoyable even tho I didn't go to lecture that much. Love you Dr. Chu.

I have a feeling this will be the best professor I will have for the rest of my time here even though I'm a first-year fall freshman. Super easy to approach, super clear on grading, super helpful lectures, super helpful online supplemental assignments, and super easy to understand review on Canvas. I loved him, wish I could have him for every math.

He was one of the most genuine professors I have had. He cared about the students enough to learn the names of most of the first 3 rows of students. He would start off class with something interesting and to engage us into the lecture, and it worked. Explained everything clearly and made sure we understood. Very approachable, would recommend.

He's the sweetest prof I've ever had, this semester was his first time teaching his own class but he explains really well and he'll put in effort to make sure you understand when you have a question. He also puts in a lot of effort to get to know all his students. I recommend him 100%. Test are structured like other math courses.

Goes through material at a good pace and always encourages students to ask questions. Response extremely quickly to emails and is helpful outside of class. Genuinely seems to care a lot about his students.

Chu was probably one of if not the best math teachers I've ever had. He deeply cares about his students, memorizing each of their names and putting them first even when he's on other business. His lectures are very entertaining, and makes sure that every engaged student completely understands what he's covering.
Good lecturer, lowkey funny, cares about students

Although he is newer, Professor Chu is probably one of my favorite professors/teachers for math. 251 can be a lot, but if you are willing to put in the effort, he will help you out with a smile. He celebrates your wins along with you. Genuinely such a caring prof, tries to learn all of his students' names too. Take him if you can!

Chu is the best Math professor I have had. He genuinely cares about each student, making a point to memorize everyone's name, constantly ask for feedback to improve lectures, and always ask for any questions before moving on. You can tell he truly loves math, and his main goal is making us feel the same.
